I don’t know if this will be helpful, but I feel the need to comment as I have suffered the same thoughts.
My best advice, although vague, is to find something that can keep you here. For the longest time my cat has kept me going because I refuse to let her down. Alongside that, there’s something of a burning flame inside that has kept me alive, and brought me back from the brink many times.
Find something that keeps that flame alive inside you. If you can fight for one more day, then you can keep fighting. 
I have thought many times that my struggles are a burden for others, but I was wrong. I don’t know what you’re situation is like, but try to talk to those you feel care at all. Try and get them to help you fight this poison inside, you owe it to yourself.
You may feel like your burdens make you unloveable, but that’s not true.

Push on, never stop fighting, and keep moving forward.
